extDescription.message: Capture the whole page as one image — no scrolling, no blank bands. The image never leaves your browser.

errDevtoolsOpen.message: DevTools is open — close it and try again. The browser allows only one debugger at a time.

errRestricted.message: This page is protected by the browser itself (chrome://, the extension store and similar). It works on ordinary sites.

errGeneric.message: The capture failed. Reload the page and try again.

viewerExpired.message: This image is no longer available. A capture is held in memory only and never written to disk — take the screenshot again.

clamped.message: The page is taller than the browser can put in one image: $CAPTURED$ px captured, full height $TOTAL$ px.

someImagesPending.message: $COUNT$ images did not finish loading — reload the page and try again.

errJpegTooLarge.message: This image is too large for JPEG — save it as PNG.

errPdfFailed.message: Could not build the PDF — the image is too large. Save it as PNG instead.

innerScroll.message: This page scrolls inside a panel rather than as a document (Gmail, dashboards and similar apps). The browser cannot render the part of such a panel that is off screen, so only the visible area was captured.
